terms.definitionEn: An element whose children participate in a one-dimensional flexible layout.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر أبناؤه بيشاركوا في تخطيط مرن على محور واحد.

terms.definitionEn: A child participating in the flexible layout created by its parent.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر ابن بيشارك في التخطيط المرن اللي عامله الأب.

terms.definitionEn: A display value that creates a flexible formatting context for an element's children.
terms.definitionAr: قيمة display بتعمل سياق تخطيط مرن للعناصر الأبناء.

terms.definitionEn: A property that sets the direction of the flexible layout's main axis.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد اتجاه المحور الرئيسي للتخطيط المرن.

terms.definitionEn: A property that distributes items along the main axis when free space is available.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتوزع العناصر على المحور الرئيسي لما تكون فيه مساحة فاضية.

terms.definitionEn: A property that aligns items on the cross axis within each flex line.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحاذي العناصر على المحور المتقاطع داخل كل سطر flex.

terms.definitionEn: A property that controls whether items may continue on additional flex lines.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد إذا العناصر ممكن تكمل على أسطر flex إضافية.

terms.definitionEn: A property that sets gutters between rows and columns in a layout container.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد المسافات بين الصفوف والأعمدة في حاوية التخطيط.

terms.definitionEn: A factor that controls how an item may receive positive free space along the main axis.
terms.definitionAr: معامل بيتحكم في نصيب العنصر من المساحة الفاضية على المحور الرئيسي.

terms.definitionEn: A factor that controls how an item may surrender space when the flex line is too small.
terms.definitionAr: معامل بيتحكم في مقدار تقليص العنصر لما مساحة السطر ما تكفيش.

terms.definitionEn: A preferred initial main size used before free space is distributed among items.
terms.definitionAr: حجم رئيسي مبدئي مفضل بيتحدد قبل توزيع المساحة بين العناصر.

terms.definitionEn: The axis perpendicular to the main axis in a flexible layout.
terms.definitionAr: المحور العمودي على المحور الرئيسي في التخطيط المرن.

questions.question: What layout context does this declaration create for the toolbar's children?
options: A flexible layout with a main axis
A two-dimensional grid with fixed tracks
questions.explanation: display: flex makes the element a flex container and its in-flow children flex items.
questions.explanationAr: display: flex بتخلي العنصر flex container وأبناؤه عناصر flex.

questions.question: In the usual horizontal writing mode, which way does the main axis run?
options: From the center toward both edges
questions.explanation: row follows the inline axis, which is horizontal in the usual horizontal writing mode.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة row بتمشي مع محور inline، وده أفقي في الكتابة الأفقية المعتادة.

questions.question: Which spacing behavior does space-between request?
options: Equal gaps before the first and after the last item
Items centered on the cross axis
Free space between items; ends stay at the edges
questions.explanation: space-between places the first and last items at the main-axis edges and distributes free space between items.
questions.explanationAr: space-between بتحط أول وآخر عنصر عند الطرفين وبتوزع المساحة بينهم.

questions.question: What may happen when the current flex line runs out of space?
options: Items are forced to shrink to zero width
The container becomes a grid automatically
Items can continue on another flex line
questions.explanation: wrap permits flex items to form additional lines when needed.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة wrap بتسمح للعناصر تكمل على أسطر إضافية عند الحاجة.

questions.question: What is the declared main-axis direction?
questions.explanation: The declared flex-direction value is column.
questions.explanationAr: القيمة المحددة للخاصية هي column.

questions.prompt: Make the navigation element a flex container.
questions.explanation: The flex display value establishes flexible layout for the children.
questions.explanationAr: قيمة flex بتعمل تخطيط مرن للعناصر الأبناء.

questions.prompt: Place the flex items on a vertical main axis.
questions.explanation: column sets the main axis in the block direction.
questions.explanationAr: column بتخلي المحور الرئيسي في اتجاه block.

questions.question: Which axis does align-items use for this single flex line?
options: The page's inline axis in every direction
A new axis for each child
questions.explanation: align-items aligns flex items on the cross axis of each line.
questions.explanationAr: align-items بتحاذي العناصر على المحور المتقاطع لكل سطر.

questions.code: .row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
questions.question: Which direction does justify-content center items along here?
options: The inline direction of each item's text
questions.explanation: With flex-direction: column, the main axis runs in the column direction.
questions.explanationAr: مع flex-direction: column، المحور الرئيسي بيمشي في اتجاه العمود.

questions.code:
.row { display: flex; justify-content: flex-start; }
.row { justify-content: center; }
questions.explanation: The declarations have equal origin, importance, layer, and specificity, so the later value wins.
questions.explanationAr: القواعد متساوية في الأصل والأهمية والطبقة والـ specificity، فالقيمة الأخيرة بتكسب.

questions.prompt: Center items across the cross axis of a row flex container.
questions.explanation: center aligns items on the cross axis.
questions.explanationAr: center بتحاذي العناصر على المحور المتقاطع.

questions.prompt: Allow cards to move to additional flex lines.
questions.explanation: wrap lets items form multiple lines instead of requiring a single line.
questions.explanationAr: wrap بتسمح للعناصر تتوزع على أكتر من سطر.

questions.question: Where does gap add spacing?
options: Around the outside of the container
Between an item and its border
questions.explanation: gap creates gutters between items or flex lines, not outer margins around the container.
questions.explanationAr: gap بتعمل مسافات بين العناصر أو الأسطر، مش حول الحاوية من بره.

questions.prompt: Set a one-rem gutter between flex items.
questions.explanation: gap accepts a length for the space between items or lines.
questions.explanationAr: gap بتقبل طول للمسافة بين العناصر أو الأسطر.

questions.question: What does a positive grow factor allow an item to do?
options: Move itself to a new flex line
questions.explanation: flex-grow distributes positive free space among items according to their grow factors.
questions.explanationAr: flex-grow بتوزع المساحة الفاضية الموجبة حسب معاملات النمو.

questions.prompt: Give this card a preferred initial main size of 14rem.
questions.explanation: flex-basis provides a preferred initial size along the main axis.
questions.explanationAr: flex-basis بتحدد حجمًا مبدئيًا مفضلًا على المحور الرئيسي.

questions.question: What value does this shorthand assign to flex-grow?
questions.explanation: The three-value flex shorthand sets grow, shrink, then basis; its first value is 2.
questions.explanationAr: اختصار flex بثلاث قيم بيرتب grow ثم shrink ثم basis، وأول قيمة هنا 2.

questions.question: What happens to this item's main size when free space is distributed?
options: It grows to absorb remaining space
It shrinks first whenever siblings are present
It takes the full width of the container
questions.explanation: The shorthand sets grow and shrink to zero and the basis to 12rem.
questions.explanationAr: الاختصار بيحدد grow وshrink بصفر وbasis بقيمة 12rem.

questions.prompt: Allow this item to surrender space when its flex line is too small.
questions.explanation: A positive flex-shrink factor allows the item to shrink when needed.
questions.explanationAr: معامل flex-shrink موجب بيسمح بتقليص العنصر وقت الحاجة.

questions.prompt: Set grow to 1, shrink to 1, and a zero initial main size.
questions.explanation: The three-part shorthand is grow, shrink, then basis.
questions.explanationAr: الاختصار المكون من 3 أجزاء ترتيبه grow ثم shrink ثم basis.

questions.question: How do the main and cross axes relate to flex-direction?
keyPoints: flex-direction sets the main axis direction
The cross axis is perpendicular to the main axis
questions.modelAnswer: flex-direction establishes the main axis, and the cross axis runs perpendicular to it. Their physical directions depend on the writing mode, so row is not universally equivalent to left-to-right.
questions.explanation: Flex alignment is defined relative to axes rather than fixed screen directions.
questions.explanationAr: محاور flex بتتحدد بالنسبة لبعضها واتجاهها الفعلي بيتأثر بنمط الكتابة.

questions.question: When should justify-content and align-items be used?
keyPoints: justify-content distributes items along the main axis
align-items aligns items along the cross axis
questions.modelAnswer: Use justify-content to distribute items along the main axis and align-items to align them on the cross axis. Because flex-direction changes the main axis, the corresponding physical direction can change too.
questions.explanation: The two properties operate on different flex axes.
questions.explanationAr: الخاصيتين بيشتغلوا على محورين مختلفين، واتجاههم بيتحدد بـ flex-direction.

questions.question: How do wrapping and gap work together in a flex layout?
keyPoints: gap sets space between items or lines
Gutters are internal rather than outer margins
questions.modelAnswer: flex-wrap lets items continue onto additional lines when the available main-axis space is insufficient. gap adds consistent gutters between items and between flex lines without adding outer space around the container.
questions.explanation: Wrapping controls line formation and gap controls internal gutters.
questions.explanationAr: الـ wrap بتحدد تكوين الأسطر والـ gap بتحدد المسافات الداخلية بينهم.

questions.question: What roles do flex-grow, flex-shrink, and flex-basis play?
keyPoints: basis supplies a preferred initial main size
The shorthand lists grow, shrink, then basis
questions.modelAnswer: flex-basis supplies the preferred initial main size, flex-grow distributes positive free space, and flex-shrink controls how items respond when space is insufficient. The flex shorthand lists those values in grow, shrink, basis order.
questions.explanation: These components describe different stages of flexible item sizing.
questions.explanationAr: القيم دي بتحدد الحجم المبدئي والتعامل مع المساحة الزيادة أو الناقصة.
